code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    a=next((i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==1)
    b=next((i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==2)
    r,c=a; tr,tc=b
    dr=1 if tr>r else -1 if tr<r else 0
    dc=1 if tc>c else -1 if tc<c else 0
    # Travel diagonally, then in the dominant remaining direction, stopping adjacent to 2.
    while abs(tr-r)>1 and abs(tc-c)>1:
        r+=dr; c+=dc; g[r][c]=3
    while max(abs(tr-r),abs(tc-c))>1:
        if abs(tr-r)>1: r+=dr
        elif abs(tc-c)>1: c+=dc
        else: break
        g[r][c]=3
    return g
'''
